annotations.text:
Insula — UI spec, EN→RO MVP.

Every artboard has a Light/Dark tweak (chip above the frame). Player and Review default to dark — commute and evening contexts.

Romanian text is always set in the serif (Newsreader); UI runs in Schibsted Grotesk.
Onboarding & Home — login, first-run empty state (teaches the method in 3 lines), islands list with due-reviews banner, island detail with the capture → translate → audio pipeline.
Commute & Review — dark by default. Player: transport controls in the bottom half, mode switcher, shadow-gap stepper. Review: FSRS grades with projected intervals, bottom-anchored.

Content — presets gallery with level badges and one-tap import, transcript wizard (paste → analyzing → study list), settings with plan usage meters. Preset detail shows the not-yet-imported state; after import the CTA becomes 'Open island' with an Imported badge (see the gallery's Restaurant row).
Desktop & Admin — responsive Islands Home at 1440 (sidebar nav replaces the tab bar), admin preset builder with per-row pipeline statuses and publish toggle.
